With disconcerting ease, Aegwynn battered the demonlord with her powers and succeeded in killing his physical shell. Fearing that Sargeras' spirit would linger on, Aegwynn locked the ruined husk of his body within one of the ancient halls of Kalimdor that had been blasted to the bottom of the sea when the Well of Eternity collapsed.

The sharpest shears and most delicate ha.cs: Nejostřejší nůžky a nejjemnější ruce najdeš v Curls and Furls tady v Trade District. Podívej se, jestli máš chvíli a chceš si nechat trochu ostříhat.
The sharpest shears and most delicate ha.en: The sharpest shears and most delicate hands are found at Curls and Furls here in the trade district. Take a gander if you have some spare time and are interested in taking a little off the top.

The shen'dorei will always owe the spiri.cs:
Shen'dorei budou duchům navždy dlužit za jejich pomoc a Windshapeři přísahali, že ten dluh splatí a vrátí věci do starých kolejí. Bez duchů, kteří by nás vedli, jsme bohužel nebezpečně slepí k tomu, co se kolem nás ve Skywallu děje.

High Order jsou krátkozrací a arogantní, přesně jako jejich předkové Highborne. Chtějí magii tohohle místa ovládnout a podrobit si ji. Právě tahle cesta nás kdysi donutila uprchnout z Kalimdoru a usadit se tady. Bojím se, že stejně jako u našich předků jejich sebevědomí dalece předběhlo jejich schopnosti a skončit to může katastrofou.
The shen'dorei will always owe the spiri.en: The shen'dorei will always owe the spirits a debt for their aid, and the Windshapers have sworn an oath to repay that debt and restore things to the way they were before. Unfortunately, we are dangerously blind to what is happening around us within Skywall without the spirits to guide us. The High Order are shortsighted and arrogant, just like their Highborne ancestors. They seek to master and control the magic of this place. This is very path that led us to flee from Kalimdor and reside here in the first place. I fear that much like our forebears their confidence has vastly outpaced their competence and the end result could be disastrous.

The shen'dorei will always owe the spiri.cs:
Shen'dorei budou vždy dlužit duchům za jejich pomoc a Windshapers přísahali, že tento dluh splatí a obnoví věci tak, jak byly. Bohužel jsme nebezpečně slepí k tomu, co se kolem nás ve Skywall děje, bez duchů, kteří by nás vedli.

High Order je krátkozraký a arogantní, stejně jako jejich highborne předkové. Snaží se ovládnout a řídit magii tohoto místa. To je přesně ta cesta, která nás vedla k útěku z Kalimdoru a k životu tady. Obávám se, že stejně jako naši předkové mají sebevědomí, které daleko předčí jejich schopnosti, a výsledek by mohl být katastrofální.
The shen'dorei will always owe the spiri.en: The shen'dorei will always owe the spirits a debt for their aid, and the Windshapers have sworn an oath to repay that debt and restore things to the way they were before. Unfortunately, we are dangerously blind to what is happening around us within Skywall without the spirits to guide us. The High Order are shortsighted and arrogant, just like their highborne ancestors. They seek to master and control the magic of this place. This is the very path that led us to flee from Kalimdor and reside here in the first place. I fear that much like our forebears their confidence has vastly outpaced their competence and the end result could be disastrous.

The spirits have guided you to me. How m.cs: Duchové tě ke mně přivedli. Jak ti mohu posloužit?
The spirits have guided you to me. How m.en: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

The spirits of the wind may have left us.cs:
Duchové větru nás možná opustili, ale moc živlů není úplně mimo dosah pro ty, kdo mají trpělivost je hledat.

Pokud jsi zasvěcen do cest šamana, pomůžu ti je pochopit.
The spirits of the wind may have left us.en: The spirits of the wind may have left us, but the power of the elements is not entirely out of reach for those with the patience to seek them out. If you are initiated in the ways of the shaman, I can help you grasp them.

Then it is to Taim Ragetotem that you mu.cs: Pak musíš promluvit s Taimem Ragetotem. Hledej ho na Hunter Rise.
Then it is to Taim Ragetotem that you mu.en: Then it is to Taim Ragetotem that you must speak. Seek him out on the Hunter Rise.

There are costs with war, {C}... ones of.cs:
Válka má svou cenu, {C}… cenu, kterou lidé často přehlížejí. Jsou to sirotci – děti, které přišly o rodiče v příliš mnoha konfliktech, jež zuří po celém Azerothu. Děti, které nemají nikoho jiného, často přicházejí sem a žijí tu, dokud nejsou dost staré, aby se o sebe postaraly.

Jeden týden v roce, na jaře, Aliance věnuje chvíli tomu, aby těmto nevinným něco vrátila. Říká se tomu Children's Week.
There are costs with war, {C}... ones of.en: There are costs with war, {C}... ones often overlooked. Those costs are the orphans - children who have lost their parents to the far-too-numerous conflicts that rage across Azeroth. Those children who have no one else to turn to often come here to live until they are old enough to fend for themselves. One week out of the year during the Spring, the Alliance takes time to give something back to these innocents. This time is called Children's Week.

There are many establishments where you.cs: Ve Stormwindu je mnoho podniků, kde se dá napít, ale jen jeden tě nechá přespat. Zajdi do The Gilded Rose v Trade District. Slyšel jsem, že pokoj stojí rozumně a prostěradla jsou čistá.
There are many establishments where you.en: There are many establishments where you can get a drink in Stormwind, but only one will let you spend the night. Head over to the Gilded Rose in the Trade District. I've heard the cost of a room is reasonable and the sheets are clean.

There are quite a few trainers available.cs: V Elwynnu je k dispozici několik trenérů.  Který z nich hledáš?
There are quite a few trainers available.en: There are quite a few trainers available in Elwynn. Which one are you looking for?

There are those that would teach you of.cs: Naučit tě Herbalism mohou ti, kdo sídlí ve velkém Thunder Bluffu na severu. Jdi po cestě z vesnice a u úpatí útesu vyjeď výtahem na vrchol. Je tam mnoho Bluffwatchers, kteří ti poradí dál.
There are those that would teach you of.en: There are those that would teach you of Herbalism in the great home of Thunder Bluff away to the north. Follow the road out of the village to get there and at the base of the bluff ride the elevator to the top of the rise. There are many Bluffwatchers there who can direct you further.

There is a Wind Rider Master in the grea.cs: Wind Rider Master je ve velkém městě Thunder Bluff na severu. Vyjeď výtahem od úpatí Thunder Bluffu nahoru a zeptej se tam některého z Bluffwatchers, kam dál.
There is a Wind Rider Master in the grea.en: There is a Wind Rider Master in the great city of Thunder Bluff to the north. Ride the elevator from the base of Thunder Bluff to the top and ask one of the Bluffwatchers there for further instructions.

There is a large tent on the east side o.cs: Na východní straně Bloodhoof Village je velký stan. Čeká tam na tebe Narm Skychaser.
There is a large tent on the east side o.en: There is a large tent on the east side of Bloodhoof Village. You will find Narm Skychaser awaiting you there.

There is a mailbox located conveniently.cs: Poštovní schránka je pohodlně přímo mezi Stormwind Bank a hostincem The Gilded Rose v Trade District.
There is a mailbox located conveniently.en: There is a mailbox located conveniently right between the Stormwind Bank and The Gilded Rose Inn in the Trade District.

There is a symmetry in the idea of the h.cs: V myšlence, že kůže tvého nepřítele ti poskytuje ochranu, je jistá symetrie. Chceš-li si zdokonalit koželužství, hledej Unu v Thunder Bluff Armorers na Middle Rise.
There is a symmetry in the idea of the h.en: There is a symmetry in the idea of the hide of your enemy providing you with protection. To further your leatherworking skills look for Una inside the Thunder Bluff Armorers on the middle rise.

There is no finer cook in Thunder Bluff.cs:
V Thunder Bluffu nenajdeš lepší kuchařku než Asku Mistrunner. Mmmm, cítím odsud, co vaří. Zajdi do její kuchyně na High Rise.

Sakra… mám hlad.
There is no finer cook in Thunder Bluff.en: There is no finer cook in Thunder Bluff than Aska Mistrunner. Mmmmm, I can smell what she is cooking from here. Head over to her kitchen located on the high rise. Drat... now I am hungry.

There's a Bat Handler inside the Underci.cs: V Undercity je Bat Handler. Jdi po cestě na jih z Brillu a na T-křižovatce zahni na západ. Ruins of Lordaeron budou po tvé levici. Vejdi do nich a sestup do Undercity. Tam se můžeš zeptat Undercity Guardiana na další pomoc.
There's a Bat Handler inside the Underci.en: There's a Bat Handler inside the Undercity. Head south down the road out of Brill, then west at the T-intersection. The Ruins of Lordaeron will be on your left. Go into them and then down into the Undercity. You can ask an Undercity Guardian there for further assistance.

There's a great cook who works at the Pi.cs: V Pig and Whistle Tavern v Old Town pracuje skvělý kuchař. Viděl jsem, jak při vaření používá nůž, a mezi námi, myslím, že kuchařem nebyl vždycky. Nechápej mě špatně… pokud se chceš učit, je nejlepší, jakého máme.
There's a great cook who works at the Pi.en: There's a great cook who works at the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Old Town. I've watched him use a knife when he cooks and just between you and me, I don't think he's always been a cook. Don't get me wrong... if you still want to learn, he's the best we have.

There's nothing quite like communing wit.cs: Nic se nevyrovná splynutí s přírodou… nebo to aspoň tvrdí noční elfové. Já na povídání s květinami a stromy moc nejsem, ale jsem si jistý, že Tannysa ti pomůže. Je v Mage Quarter před Alchemy Needs.
There's nothing quite like communing wit.en: There's nothing quite like communing with nature... or at least that's what the night elves tell me. I'm not much for talking to flowers and trees, but I'm sure Tannysa could help you out. She's over in the Mage Quarter outside of Alchemy Needs.

Therum Deepforge is the dwarf you want t.cs: S Therumem Deepforgem chceš mluvit, to je ten trpaslík. Podle mě jeden z nejlepších kovářů široko daleko. Najdeš ho v srdci Dwarven District.
Therum Deepforge is the dwarf you want t.en: Therum Deepforge is the dwarf you want to talk to. One of the finest blacksmiths around if you ask me. You can find him in the heart of the Dwarven District.

These great beasts know paths that ye ca.cs: Tahle velká zvířata znají cesty, které pěšky nenajdeš. Dostanou tě tam rychle a možná ti cestou ukážou i něco nového.
These great beasts know paths that ye ca.en: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

This Armor Marker is good for one piece.cs: Tento poukaz platí na jeden kus kožené nebo látkové zbroje a dá se uplatnit u Timberlainových v Eastvale Logging Camp.
This Armor Marker is good for one piece.en: This Armor Marker is good for one piece of leather or cloth armor, redeemable at the Timberlain household within the Eastvale Logging Camp.

This monument is dedicated to all those.cs: Tento památník je věnován všem, kdo padli při obraně Stormwindu. Náš lid přestál neuvěřitelné strádání, aby si uchoval svobodu a mohl sám rozhodovat o svém osudu. Právě tady vzpomínáme na každou oběť, kterou naši občané přinesli v první válce, jež náš lid postihla.
This monument is dedicated to all those.en: This monument is dedicated to all those who have fallen in the protection of Stormwind. Our people have weathered unbelievable hardships to retain their freedoms and to control their own destinies. It is here we remember every sacrifice our citizens have made during the first war that riddled our people.

Thorfin Stoneshield came to us all the w.cs: Thorfin Stoneshield k nám přišel až z Ironforge, aby nám předal své lovecké znalosti. Jestli ti nevadí dýchat zakouřený vzduch Dwarven District, najdeš ho v jeho domě v severovýchodní části čtvrti.
Thorfin Stoneshield came to us all the w.en: Thorfin Stoneshield came to us all the way from Ironforge to bring us his expertise in hunting. If you don't mind breathing the smoke filled air of the Dwarven District then you'll find him at his house in the northeast area of the district.

Thus empowered, the Five Aspects were ch.cs: Takto zmocněni byli Five Aspects pověřeni obranou světa v nepřítomnosti Titánů. S draky připravenými střežit své stvoření Titáni Azeroth navždy opustili. Bohužel bylo jen otázkou času, kdy se Sargeras dozví o existenci nově zrozeného světa….
Thus empowered, the Five Aspects were ch.en: Thus empowered, the Five Aspects were charged with the world's defense in the Titans' absence. With the dragons prepared to safeguard their creation, the Titans left Azeroth behind forever. Unfortunately it was only a matter of time before Sargeras learned of the newborn world's existence....

To learn to be one with Nature in the ey.cs: Naučit se být jedno s Přírodou v očích Matky Země je věc cti. Pokud chceš poznat cesty Lovce, musíš najít Yawa Sharpmanea na severním konci Bloodhoof Village.
To learn to be one with Nature in the ey.en: To learn to be one with Nature in the eyes of the Earth Mother, this is a matter of pride. If your will is to learn the ways of the Hunter you must seek out Yaw Sharpmane at the north end of Bloodhoof Village.

Tucked away in the Mage Quarter, there i.cs: Schovaný v Mage Quarter je malý obchod jménem Alchemy Needs. Cestou Mage Quarter potkáš všelijaké podivné obchůdky, ale když se budeš držet vnějšího okraje, určitě ho najdeš.
Tucked away in the Mage Quarter, there i.en: Tucked away in the Mage Quarter, there is a little shop called Alchemy Needs. You're bound to see all sort of strange shops on your way through the Mage Quarter, but if you stick to the outer rim you'll be sure to find it.

Unfortunately we do not have one who tea.cs: Bohužel tu v Bloodhoof Village nemáme nikoho, kdo by učil Tailoring, ale trenéra najdeš v Thunder Bluffu. Jdi po cestě na sever z vesnice, dokud nenarazíš na výtahy. Vyjeď jedním na vrchol a zeptej se některého z Bluffwatchers na cestu.
Unfortunately we do not have one who tea.en: Unfortunately we do not have one who teaches Tailoring here in Bloodhoof Village, but you can find a trainer in Thunder Bluff. Follow the path north out of the village until you come to a set of elevators. Take one up to the top of the rise and ask one of the Bluffwatchers there for directions.

Us is busy with important things!.cs: My mít práci s důležitými věcmi!
Us is busy with important things!.en: Us is busy with important things!

Vira Younghoof keeps her practice inside.cs: Vira Younghoof má svou praxi v dlouhém domě na západní straně vesnice.
Vira Younghoof keeps her practice inside.en: Vira Younghoof keeps her practice inside the long house on the west side of the village.

Want to learn leatherworking, eh? Simon.cs: Chceš se naučit koželužství, co? Simon Tanner by tě mohl naučit. Najdeš ho v Old Town v Protective Hide.
Want to learn leatherworking, eh? Simon.en: Want to learn leatherworking, eh? Simon Tanner would be able to teach you. He can be found in Old Town at the Protective Hide.

Want to make your demons more powerful?.cs: Chceš své démony zesílit? Něco to bude stát, ale přišel jsi na správné místo.
Want to make your demons more powerful?.en: Want to make your demons more powerful? It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

Warlocks, eh. Well, you didn't hear it f.cs: Warlocks, co. No, tohle jsi ode mě neslyšel, ale slyšel jsem zvěsti, že se takoví scházejí v hospodě jménem Slaughtered Lamb v Mage Quarter.
Warlocks, eh. Well, you didn't hear it f.en: Warlocks, eh. Well, you didn't hear it from me, but I've heard rumors that those types gather at a bar called the Slaughtered Lamb in the Mage Quarter.

We don't have a bank here in Brill, you'.cs: V Brillu banku nemáme, budeš muset do Undercity. Vzadu v Ruins of Lordaeron na jihu jsou výtahy, které tě svezou dolů do Undercity. Až tam budeš, zeptej se některého z Undercity Guardians na přesnější cestu.
We don't have a bank here in Brill, you'.en: We don't have a bank here in Brill, you'll have to go to the Undercity for that. At the back of the Ruins of Lordaeron to the south are elevators that will take you down into the Undercity. Once there ask one of the Undercity Guardians for more precise directions.

We live and die, and the land remains, e.cs: Žijeme a umíráme, a země zůstává – věčná, nedotčená naším odchodem. Země proto nemůže patřit nám, {N}. My patříme jí. A tak zemi chráníme, protože bez ní nemáme naději přežít.
We live and die, and the land remains, e.en: We live and die, and the land remains, eternal, unmoved by our passage. Thus, land cannot belong to us, {N}. Instead, we belong to it. Therefore we protect the land, for without it we cannot hope to survive.

Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We off.cs: Vítej ve Stormwindské bance. Nabízíme účty a bezpečnostní schránky na cennosti. Máš už u nás účet?
Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We off.en: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

Welcome to the Stormwind Guild Registry.cs: Vítej v kancelářích Stormwind Guild Registry. S čím ti dnes mohu pomoci?
Welcome to the Stormwind Guild Registry.en: Welcome to the Stormwind Guild Registry offices. What can I help you with today?

Welcome, my brother. If you are here to.cs:
Vítej, bratře. Pokud ses přišel učit, rád tě vycvičím.

Jsme strážci rovnováhy, nyní i navždy, jak nás učil Cenarius. Nikdy na to nezapomeň.
Welcome, my brother. If you are here to.en: Welcome, my brother. If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you. We are the preservers of the balance, now and forever, as Cenarius has taught us. Never forget this.

Well there's a gryphon master up in Stor.cs: No, ve Stormwindu je mistr gryphonů, pokud potřebuješ někam letět.  Měl bys být schopni vidět gryfony přistávající po tvé pravici, když procházíš údolím hrdinů.
Well there's a gryphon master up in Stor.en: Well there's a gryphon master up in Stormwind if you need to fly somewhere. You should be able to see the gryphons landing on your right as you walk through the Valley of Heroes.

Well, you can find Theridan or Maldryn b.cs: No, Theridana nebo Maldryna najdeš u měsíční studny v Parku. Stačí zamířit do západní části Stormwindu, na sever od Mage District, ale západně od Cathedral Square.
Well, you can find Theridan or Maldryn b.en: Well, you can find Theridan or Maldryn by the moonwell in the Park. Just head to the western area of Stormwind, north of the Mage District, but west of the Cathedral Square.

Smíchej a přiveď k varu. Nech vařit nejméně dvě hodiny, než budeš podávat.
Westfall Stew 3 parts Stringy Vulture Me.en: Westfall Stew 3 parts Stringy Vulture Meat 3 Goretusk Snouts 3 Murloc Eyes 3 Okra Mix together and bring to a boil. Let simmer for at least two hours before serving.

What I wouldn't give to be out on the op.cs: Co bych dal za to být v takový den venku na otevřených pláních… ale moje povinnost mě váže.
What I wouldn't give to be out on the op.en: What I wouldn't give to be out on the open plains on a day like this... but, my duty binds me.

What can you do at an inn? Well when you.cs:
Co se dá dělat v hostinci?

Když v hostinci přenocuješ, odpočineš si velmi pohodlně. Díky tomu se u tebe mnohem rychleji objeví „well rested“ než v divočině. Když jsi dobře odpočatý, učíš se ze zkušeností víc.

U kteréhokoli hostinského si také můžeš vzít hearthstone a později ho použít, abys se rychle vrátil do toho hostince.
What can you do at an inn? Well when you.en: What can you do at an inn? Well when you stay at an inn, you rest very comfortably. Because of this, you will become "well rested" much more quickly than you would in the wilderness. When you are well rested, you learn more from experience. You may also speak with any innkeeper to get a hearthstone, and can later use the hearthstone in order to quickly return to that inn.

What could you possibly need a bank for?.cs: K čemu bys mohl potřebovat banku? Dobrá, budeš muset projít Ruins of Lordaeron jižně od Brillu. Vzadu jsou výtahy vedoucí dolů do Undercity. Až tam budeš, zastav kteréhokoli z těch těžkopádných Abomination, kterým říkají Undercity Guardian, a zeptej se ho na přesnější cestu.
What could you possibly need a bank for?.en: What could you possibly need a bank for? Very well, you'll need to go through the Ruins of Lordaeron to the south of Brill. In the back are a set of elevators leading down into the Undercity. When you get there stop any of those lumbering Abominations they like to call an Undercity Guardian and ask it for better directions.

What do you need directions to?.en: What do you need directions to?

What do you need of me, child of Zephras.cs: Co ode mě potřebuješ, dítě Zephrasu?
What do you need of me, child of Zephras.en: What do you need of me, child of Zephras?

What may I do for you, fellow windshaper.cs: Co pro tebe můžu udělat, druhu windshapere?
What may I do for you, fellow windshaper.en: What may I do for you, fellow windshaper?

What? I don't know of any warlock traine.cs:
Co? Neznám žádné trenéry warlocků ve Stormwindu.

Ale… Byly zaznamenány náznaky démonické činnosti u The Slaughtered Lamb v Mage Quarter. Asi bys to tam mohl zkontrolovat.
What? I don't know of any warlock traine.en: What? I don't know of any warlock trainers in Stormwind. Although... There have been some sightings of demonic activity over by The Slaughtered Lamb in the Mage Quarter. I suppose you could check there.

When mounted on the back of a wind rider.cs: Když sedíš na hřbetě wind ridera, vidíš, že jeho pověst síly a rychlosti je plně zasloužená.
When mounted on the back of a wind rider.en: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

Where are you going? Well if you're look.cs: Kam máš namířeno? Jestli se tam chceš dostat rychle, jsi na správném místě!
Where are you going? Well if you're look.en: Where are you going? Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

Where is it ye would like to go lad? For.cs: Kam bys chtěl jít, chlapče? Za pár mincí tě tam moji Gryfoni dostanou rychleji než i ten nejrychlejší kůň.
Where is it ye would like to go lad? For.en: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

Which battleground are you interested in.en: Which battleground are you interested in?

Which class trainer are you looking for?.en: Which class trainer are you looking for?

Which profession trainer are you looking.en: Which profession trainer are you looking for?

While there's no Engineering Trainer in.cs: V Brillu žádného trenéra Engineering nemáme, ale jeden je dole v Undercity. Dostaneš se tam tak, že zajdeš až dozadu do Ruins of Lordaeron na jih od města a sjedeš výtahem dolů. Až tam budeš, zeptej se Undercity Guardiana na konkrétnější cestu.
While there's no Engineering Trainer in.en: While there's no Engineering Trainer in Brill, there is one down in the Undercity. To get there head to the back of the Ruins of Lordaeron to the south of town and take the elevator down. Once you get there ask an Undercity Guardian for more specific directions.

While we have no Alchemy Trainer here in.cs: Tady v Bloodhoof Village nemáme Alchemy Trainera, ale v Thunder Bluffu na severu jeden je. Jdi po cestě tam a až budeš nahoře, zeptej se některého z Bluffwatchers na cestu.
While we have no Alchemy Trainer here in.en: While we have no Alchemy Trainer here in Bloodhoof Village, there is one in Thunder Bluff to the north. Follow the road there and ask one of the Bluffwatchers for directions when you get to the top.

Why cook when everything tastes like ash.cs: Proč vařit, když v ústech všechno chutná jako popel? Pokud ještě nějaká ústa máš. No dobře, zamiř do Undercity jižně od Brillu a zeptej se tam Undercity Guardiana na další cestu k jejich trenérovi Cooking. Dostaneš se tam výtahy dolů v zadní části Ruins of Lordaeron.
Why cook when everything tastes like ash.en: Why cook when everything tastes like ashes in your mouth? If you have one still that is. Very well, head to the Undercity south of Brill and ask an Undercity Guardian there for further directions to their Cooking Trainer. To get there you can take the elevators down from the rear of the Ruins of Lordaeron.

Woo Ping's stamina is simply astounding..cs: Woo Pingova výdrž je prostě ohromující. Když jsem ho pozoroval, jak hodiny cvičí své zbraňové techniky, bylo mi poté líto cvičného panáka. Nenapadá mě nikdo lépe se hodící k tomu, aby tě vycvičil v boji se zbraní.
Woo Ping's stamina is simply astounding..en: Woo Ping's stamina is simply astounding. Watching him practice his weapon techniques for hours on end, I felt sorry for the practice dummy afterward. I can't think of anyone better suited to train you in armed combat.

Wot kin I do fer ye?.en: Wot kin I do fer ye?

Years of quality breeding techniques and.cs: Roky kvalitních chovatelských technik a spousta péče mi dovolují tu čest ti tyto koně ukázat! Udělej si prosím čas, když je zvažujete pro své hoře. Kůň je společník na věky, příteli. Neprodávej se zkrátka – pořiď si svého oře ještě dnes!
Years of quality breeding techniques and.en: Years of quality breeding techniques and plenty of care allow me the privilege of showing you these horses! Please, take your time as you consider them for your mount. A horse is a companion for the ages, friend. Don't sell yourself short - get your steed here today!

Yet there were five flights that held do.cs: Přesto existovalo pět hejn, která měla vládu nad ostatními. Právě těchto pět hejn Titáni vybrali, aby střežila rodící se svět. Největší členové Pantheonu propůjčili část své moci vůdcům každého z hejn. Tito majestátní draci (uvedení níže) se stali známými jako Great Aspects, nebo Dragon Aspects.
Yet there were five flights that held do.en: Yet there were five flights that held dominion over their brethren. It was these five flights that the Titans chose to shepherd the budding world. The greatest members of the Pantheon imbued a portion of their power upon each of the flights' leaders. These majestic dragons (as listed below) became known as the Great Aspects, or the Dragon Aspects.

Yonn Deepcut can be found inside the gre.cs: Yonna Deepcuta najdeš ve velkém stanu v severozápadním rohu Bloodhoof Village.
Yonn Deepcut can be found inside the gre.en: Yonn Deepcut can be found inside the great tent at the northwest corner of Bloodhoof Village.

You are gonna want to head over to Old T.cs: Pokud se chceš naučit stahování kůží, zajdi do Old Town a navštiv Protective Hide.
You are gonna want to head over to Old T.en: You are gonna want to head over to Old Town and drop by the Protective Hide if you are lookin' to learn skinning.

You are looking for Uthan Stillwater. Yo.cs: Hledáš Uthana Stillwatera. Najdeš ho západně od vesnice, jak rybaří u Stonebull Lake.
You are looking for Uthan Stillwater. Yo.en: You are looking for Uthan Stillwater. You will find him west of the village, fishing at Stonebull Lake.

You can find Stormwind Harbor if you hea.cs:
Stormwind Harbor najdeš, když projdeš Canals, mezi Cathedral District a Parkem.

Hledal jsi nějaký konkrétní cíl?
You can find Stormwind Harbor if you hea.en: You can find Stormwind Harbor if you head through the Canals, between the Cathedral District and the Park. Were you looking for a specific destination?

You can find Tannysa standing outside Al.cs: Tannysu najdeš stát před Alchemy Needs v Mage Quarter.
You can find Tannysa standing outside Al.en: You can find Tannysa standing outside Alchemy Needs in the Mage Quarter.

You can find Vance Undergloom upstairs i.cs: Vance Undergloom najdeš nahoře v jednom z pokojů v Gallows' End Tavern na jihovýchodní straně Brillu.
You can find Vance Undergloom upstairs i.en: You can find Vance Undergloom upstairs in a room at the Gallows' End Tavern on the southeast side of Brill.

You can find a mailbox just outside the.cs: Poštovní schránku najdeš hned před Thunder Bluff Bank na Lower Rise.
You can find a mailbox just outside the.en: You can find a mailbox just outside the Thunder Bluff Bank on the lower rise.

You don't have the stomach for the gryph.cs: Na let gryfem nemáš žaludek, co? No, máš štěstí, máme alternativu, při které zůstaneš nohama na zemi… víceméně. Je to gnómský dopravník lidí, Deeprun Tram. Pohodlně umístěný vzadu v Dwarven District.
You don't have the stomach for the gryph.en: You don't have the stomach for the gryphon ride, huh. Well lucky for you, we have an alternative where you can keep your feet on the ground... more or less. It's the gnomish mover of people, the Deeprun Tram. Conveniently located in the back of the Dwarven District.

You honor the spirits of the animals you.cs: Duchy zvířat, která musíš zabíjet, uctíš tím, že je nenecháš přijít nazmar. Aska Mistrunner ti ukáže jak. Má kuchyni na High Rise.
You honor the spirits of the animals you.en: You honor the spirits of the animals you must slay by not letting them go to waste. Aska Mistrunner will show you how. She has a kitchen on the high rise.

You may not be a paladin, but you may ye.cs: Možná nejsi paladin, ale můžeš ještě najít útěchu ve Světle, pokud ji budeš hledat.
You may not be a paladin, but you may ye.en: You may not be a paladin, but you may yet find solace in the light should you seek it.

You may seek out Martin Lindsey inside t.cs: Martina Lindseyho najdeš v Pools of Vision pod Spirit Rise. Pomůže ti na cestě do Arathi Basin.
You may seek out Martin Lindsey inside t.en: You may seek out Martin Lindsey inside the Pools of Vision, underneath the Spirit Rise. He will assist you on your way to Arathi Basin.

You need to be exalted with the trolls o.cs: Než tě naučím jezdecké dovednosti, {C}, musíš být exalted u trollů z kmene Darkspear.
You need to be exalted with the trolls o.en: You need to be exalted with the trolls of the Darkspear tribe before I will teach you a riding skill, {C}.

You will find Pyall Silentstride inside.cs: Pyalla Silentstridea najdeš ve velkém stanu v severozápadním rohu vesnice. Může tě naučit, po čem toužíš.
You will find Pyall Silentstride inside.en: You will find Pyall Silentstride inside the great tent in the northwest corner of the village. He can teach you what you crave.

You wish to aid The Defilers in their fi.cs: Chceš pomoci The Defilers v boji proti The League of Arathor v Arathi Basin? Dobrá, požádej o pomoc Martina Lindseyho. Najdeš ho u Pools of Vision.
You wish to aid The Defilers in their fi.en: You wish to aid The Defilers in their fight against The League of Arathor in Arathi Basin? Very well, you should ask Martin Lindsey for his assistance then. Look for him in the Pools of Vision.

You'll find Carolai Anise trying to blow.cs: Carolai Anise najdeš na severozápadním konci města, jak se snaží vyhodit do vzduchu svůj dům. Co kdybys zašel a zkusil jí pomoci?
You'll find Carolai Anise trying to blow.en: You'll find Carolai Anise trying to blow up her house at the northwest end of town. Why don't you go see if you can help her?

You'll find Innkeeper Renee inside the G.cs: Innkeeper Renee najdeš v Gallows' End Tavern na jihovýchodním konci ulice, která vede městem.
You'll find Innkeeper Renee inside the G.en: You'll find Innkeeper Renee inside the Gallows' End Tavern at the southeast end of the street running through town.

Your interests would be best served by S.cs: Nejlépe ti poslouží Sir Alodan. Je s ostatními z Undercity u Pools of Vision.
Your interests would be best served by S.en: Your interests would be best served by Sir Alodan. He is with the other members of the Undercity near the Pools of Vision.

Zephras is in a state of decline, unfort.cs:
Zephras bohužel upadá. Živelní duchové větru, kteří nás sem do Skywallu přivedli před mnoha tisíci lety, zmizeli, a my jsme přišli o velkou část magie, na které jsme po tisíciletí záviseli.

Samotný ostrov je navíc nebezpečně nestálý a ztratili jsme i spojení s ostatními ostrovními provinciemi shen'dorei. Těch pár Windshaperů, kteří ještě mají dar nebeského zraku, se pokoušelo spojit s našimi bratry a sestrami na jiných ostrovech, ale odpověď nepřišla.

Mnozí z nás se bojí, že shen'dorei tady na Zephrasu jsou vším, co z našeho lidu zbylo.
Zephras is in a state of decline, unfort.en: Zephras is in a state of decline, unfortunately. The elemental wind spirits that brought us here to Skywall so many thousands of years ago have vanished, causing us to lose much of the magic on which we've depended for millennia. The island itself is also dangerously unstable, and we've even lost contact with the other island provinces of the shen'dorei. The few Windshapers that still possess the gift of skysight have attempted to contact our brothers and sisters on the other islands, but we have had no response. Many among us are worried that the shen'dorei here on Zephras are all that is left of our people.

Zephras is in great danger. The elementa.cs:
Zephras je ve velkém nebezpečí. Živelní duchové větru, kteří nás sem do Skywallu přivedli před mnoha tisíci lety, nás opustili a nechali nás zranitelné v téhle nestálé říši. Naše kdysi mocná společnost se rozkládala na mnoha ostrovních útočištích v našem koutě Skywallu, ale teď si ani nejsme jistí, jestli mimo tenhle malý ostrov ještě nějací shen'dorei zbyli.

Situace je vážná, ale High Order je odhodlaný se jí postavit.
Zephras is in great danger. The elementa.en: Zephras is in great danger. The elemental wind spirits that brought us here to Skywall so many thousands of years ago have abandoned us, leaving us vulnerable in this unstable realm. Our once-robust society spanned multiple island sanctuaries in our corner of Skywall, but now we are not even sure if any other shen'dorei remain outside of this small island. Things are dire, but the High Order is committed to rising to this challenge.
